stories.title: Ticket Creation from Web and Mobile
stories.story: As a user, I want to create support tickets from both web and mobile applications, so that I can report issues conveniently through my preferred platform.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create a support ticket through the web application.
Users can create a support ticket through the mobile application.
Each created ticket must have a unique ticket ID generated automatically.
The ticket creation process should be user-friendly and intuitive.

stories.title: Assign Tickets to Different Teams
stories.story: As a support agent, I want to assign tickets to different teams based on category, so that issues can be resolved by the appropriate team quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Support agents can assign tickets to the following categories: Billing, Technical, and General Inquiry.
Tickets should only be assignable to the permitted categories for routing.

stories.title: View Ticket History
stories.story: As a user, I want to view my ticket history and previous comments, so that I can keep track of my requests and responses.
acceptance_criteria: Users can access a list of their previous tickets.
Each ticket history entry should include previous comments and status updates.

stories.title: Ticket Status Management
stories.story: As a support agent, I want to manage ticket statuses, so that I can accurately reflect the state of each ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Ticket statuses can be set to: Open, In Progress, Waiting for Customer, Resolved, and Closed.
Users can view the current status of their tickets in the ticket history.

stories.title: SLA Tracking System
stories.story: As a support manager, I want to implement SLA tracking for priority tickets, so that we can ensure timely responses based on ticket urgency.
acceptance_criteria: The system supports SLA response times of 4 hours for high priority, 24 hours for medium priority, and 72 hours for low priority.
The SLA is displayed alongside the ticket information for both users and support agents.

stories.title: Support Dashboard for Managers
stories.story: As a support manager, I want a dashboard that displays relevant ticket metrics, so that I can monitor team performance effectively.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard includes total tickets, open vs closed tickets, and average resolution time.
The dashboard is updated in real-time to reflect the current ticket status.

stories.title: Ticket Export Functionality
stories.story: As a support manager, I want to export tickets in CSV format for reporting, so that I can analyze ticket data easily.
acceptance_criteria: Managers can export all relevant ticket data in CSV format.
The exported CSV should include ticket ID, status, priority, and resolution time.

stories.title: Email and Password Authentication
stories.story: As a user, I want to authenticate my login using my email and password, so that I can securely access the support system.
acceptance_criteria: Users can log in using their email and password.
The system should prevent login attempts with incorrect credentials.

stories.title: Performance Requirement for Ticketing System
stories.story: As a system administrator, I want the system to support performance of at least 10,000 tickets per day, so that it can handle peak loads.
acceptance_criteria: The system should be tested to handle up to 10,000 ticket transactions daily without performance degradation.

stories.title: Security and Role-Based Access Control
stories.story: As a system administrator, I want security and role-based access control implemented, so that user permissions are managed effectively.
acceptance_criteria: Users have access rights based on designated roles.
The system restricts access to sensitive information based on user permissions.
